adds.title: G1 news report on appeal to Court of Justice of Mato Grosso
adds.summary: Mato Grosso law prohibits trans athletes from competitions and an association has brought a court action challenging that prohibition before the Court of Justice of Mato Grosso.

adds.title: Civil Police investigation - Feliz Natal pizzeria incident 1 November 2025
adds.summary: On 1 November 2025 in Feliz Natal, Mato Grosso, a 39-year-old trans woman was expelled by a pizzeria owner after using the women's bathroom following complaints from staff and customers; the owner was detained for gender-identity discrimination and released on 2 November 2025 after a custody hearing subject to precautionary measures, with the case under judicial secrecy under investigation by the Civil Police and monitored by the Mato Grosso Public Prosecutor's Office.

adds.title: Court of Justice of Mato Grosso - Sinop 'gender ideology' law struck down
adds.summary: On 10 November 2022 the Mato Grosso Court of Justice granted preliminary relief holding unconstitutional Sinop's March 2022 municipal law prohibiting distribution, exhibition and dissemination of didactic material containing "gender ideology" in the city's public and private schools, on grounds of violation of the Federal Constitution and Mato Grosso Constitution and excess of municipal legislative competence, in an action brought by the Procuradoria-Geral de Justiça against the Sinop City Council with participation of OAB-MT.

adds.title: Court of Justice of Mato Grosso - state 'gender ideology' teaching ban struck down
adds.summary: On 21 August 2026 the Órgão Especial of the Mato Grosso Court of Justice unanimously declared unconstitutional the state law sanctioned in April 2026 that prohibited teaching and dissemination in state public schools of content on so-called "gender ideology," gender identity and sexual orientation, including films, music, paintings and other artistic materials, thereby voiding the ban and restoring schools' pedagogical autonomy to address gender identity and sexual orientation on grounds of formal usurpation of the Union's exclusive competence over education guidelines under Article 22 of the Federal Constitution and violation of academic freedom, pluralism of ideas, and protection against bullying and discrimination.

adds.title: Decree No. 47,306 - Social Name Card (Carteira de Nome Social)
adds.summary: On 15 December 2017 Minas Gerais instituted the Carteira de Nome Social for travestis and transexuais for exercise of rights under Decree No. 47,148 of 27 January 2017, defining social name as the designation by which the travesti or transexual person identifies and is socially recognized, providing issuance by the Civil Police via the Identification Institute with model, requirements and specifications by resolution of its Chief and validity for nominal treatment and identification in state public administration, prohibiting alteration of the social name after issuance, requiring prior civil identification in the Minas Gerais Registro Geral, and requiring regulation and start of issuance within 120 days with entry into force on publication.

adds.title: Uberaba unisex restroom ban - Court of Justice of Minas Gerais 2024 ruling
adds.summary: The Court of Justice of Minas Gerais declared unconstitutional Uberaba's municipal law prohibiting unisex bathrooms almost two years after its enactment, invalidating the ban.

adds.title: Belo Horizonte religious-institutions bathroom law - Court of Justice injunction August 2025
adds.summary: In August 2025 the judiciary suspended Belo Horizonte's law restricting bathroom use by gender in temples and schools, blocking enforcement of its ban on gender-aligned bathroom access.
